tagline.en_US: KeePassXC is a free and open-source password manager. It started as a community fork of KeePassX (itself a cross-platform port of KeePass).

description.en_US: KeePassXC is a free and open-source password manager. It allows users to securely store, organize, and manage credentials and sensitive information. The application originated as a community fork of KeePassX, which was a cross-platform port of KeePass.
